items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Red Calendar was over there with Jerry Fielding.

ctx.x: Yes. And I ran into a couple of my old cronies. Red Calendar was over there with Jerry Fielding. He played, you know. Different bands got up and played, you know. And I said, 'Well, this looks all right.' So I joined the union, but I didn't get any jobs, because I didn't know anyone, you know, other than the fellows who were appearing down at the Lighthouse, and that was already organized. They had their men down there, you know, that was, how do you say it? Enconced? Is that the word?
